messages:
maria: Quick sync — proposing a small controlled hotpatch cohort for the driver/CUDA/ROCm regression we saw in canary. Thoughts?
aj: +1. Need to make sure marketplace AMIs are pinned for the cohort.
kevin: Agreed. Suggest 3 partner buckets: 1) marketplace AMIs (pin), 2) on-prem SI customers (manual patch), 3) cloud marketplace partners (canary flag).
sasha: What about rollout duration? I think 48h canary then expand if no regressions.
maria: 48h sounds right. Plan: create a CI job that builds pinned-driver image, deploy to 10% of traffic in marketplace region eu-west, and run our perf/regression smoke tests.
aj: Add a prereq for partner acceptance — we send them the exact driver+cuda+rocm matrix and the patch notes. Put it in the partner axolotl channel for signoff.
kevin: Matrix draft (quick):
```
- driver: 535.45.02 (hotfix)
- cuda: 12.2.2
- rocm: 5.6.1
- cuDNN: 9.3
- kernel: 6.1.x
```
We should provide fallback variants (quantized model build) in case perf drops.
sasha: Also flag that Dedicated customers with reserved capacity should be excluded from the automatic cohort unless explicitly opted-in.
maria: Good call. We'll only target self-serve marketplace AMIs + a small set of partner-managed nodes that opt in. Dedicated = manual.
aj: Can we automate rollback on regressions? deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary monitor triggered: if error-rate > 0.95x baseline OR p50 latency increases > 25% for 10m, auto rollback enabled.
kevin: Add one more safety: run the regression eval suite that checks decode fidelity on 5 canonical prompts. If any fail -> block.
sasha: Communication plan: 1) pre-announcement to partners with matrix and dates, 2) during-canary status at 6h/24h, 3) post-canary report + approved expansion. Include a fine-grained changelog.
maria: Timeline proposal: prep tomorrow, partner signoff EOD tomorrow, start canary Wed 07:00 UTC for 48h, expand Fri if clear.
aj: I'll own the AMI pin job and the marketplace rollout gate.
kevin: I'll own the partner signoff doc + fallback builds.
sasha: I'll prepare the communication templates and the eval prompt set.
maria: Action items: aj -> CI/AMI pin; kevin -> partner doc & fallback; sasha -> comms + evals. I'll coordinate deploy window and watch.
kevin: minor ask — include a short snippet to run the smoke test locally for partners: `./run_smoke.sh --image <ami> --region eu-west1`
maria: Perfect. We'll circulate the script and the exact probe endpoints.
aj: Note: ensure we don't bump default marketplace images for non-cohort users. We'll use a `cohort=true` tag and traffic split.
sasha: ACK. Also add a Slack webhook for canary alerts to #incidents if anything spikes.
maria: Okay final question — are we comfortable with the pinned driver version in the matrix? any compatibility concerns?
kevin: We verified on our corner-case infra (multi-gpu sharding). No major issues but will run nightly regression.
maria: Great. If no objections, I'll send partner pre-announce now and create the rollout ticket. :thumbsup:
aj: :thumbsup:
kevin: :thumbsup:
sasha: :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Created rollout ticket RD-4321 and canary monitor RD-CANARY-78.
